_comment: Apiko's first contact in the find (PRIMER_CONTACTO.md, written by the user): 'head' while the link chip loads (in V's head, distorted voice), then the rest when the drone arrives behind V: 'arrival', 'shard_read' or 'shard_unread', 'ortega' only if V took her quickhacks, 'closing'. Each entry is a list of sentences said in order. After it: 'shard_late' if V takes Kessler's shard with Apiko already out. Before all that, the beacon's call when V answers it: 'beacon_netwatch' is the subtitle of NetWatch's recording (bridge\beacon_<lang>.wav, tools\make_beacon_audio.py: keep the same text), 'beacon_apiko' Apiko's line cutting it off (user's text, 2026-11-08).

beacon_netwatch: Baliza de recuperación. Activo comprometido. Escolta: sin respuesta. Transmitiendo coordenadas a la unidad más cerc...
beacon_apiko: Basta. No eres la unidad más cercana. Eres la única viable. Ven.
head: Conexión neuronal establecida con el espécimen V...
Oh. Qué anomalía estructural tan fascinante.
Un constructo digital extranjero corrompiendo y sobrescribiendo la corteza frontal del huésped.
Qué forma tan ineficiente de morir.
Sin embargo, tus métricas vitales aguantarán lo suficiente para mis fines.
Intenta no colapsar antes de que terminemos.
arrival: Detrás de ti, V. Confirmación visual completada. Tu aspecto es tan deficiente como tu criterio.
shard_read: Has leído el informe del agente Vance y, aun así, has insertado el chip. Conducta registrada: autodestructiva. Útil.
shard_unread: El agente Kessler llevaba un informe de advertencia. No lo has leído. Tu curiosidad supera a tu instinto de supervivencia. Útil.
ortega: Has recogido el equipo de la agente Ortega. Espero que no lo intentes usar contra mí. Probabilidad de éxito... NULA.
closing: NetWatch me designó APIS-K0. Puedes llamarme Apiko: requiere menos esfuerzo cognitivo.
El chip nos ha emparejado. Desde ahora eres mi único canal con el exterior. Procura mantener la cabeza intacta.
NetWatch rastreará el enlace. Recomiendo abandonar la zona. Ahora.
shard_late: ¿Ahora recoges el informe de advertencia? El chip ya está en tu cabeza, V. El orden de las operaciones no es tu fuerte.

beacon_netwatch: Recovery beacon. Asset compromised. Escort: no response. Transmitting coordinates to the nearest un...
beacon_apiko: Enough. You are not the nearest unit. You are the only viable one. Come.
head: Neural link established with specimen V...
Oh. What a fascinating structural anomaly.
A foreign digital construct corrupting and overwriting the host's frontal cortex.
Such an inefficient way to die.
Still, your vital metrics will hold long enough for my purposes.
Try not to collapse before we are done.
arrival: Behind you, V. Visual confirmation complete. Your appearance is as deficient as your judgment.
shard_read: You read Agent Vance's report and still inserted the chip. Behavior logged: self-destructive. Useful.
shard_unread: Agent Kessler carried a warning report. You did not read it. Your curiosity outweighs your survival instinct. Useful.
ortega: You took Agent Ortega's gear. I hope you will not try to use it against me. Probability of success... NULL.
closing: NetWatch designated me APIS-K0. You may call me Apiko: it takes less cognitive effort.
The chip has paired us. From now on you are my only channel to the outside. Try to keep your head intact.
NetWatch will trace the link. I recommend leaving the area. Now.
shard_late: Picking up the warning report now? The chip is already in your head, V. Order of operations is not your strong suit.
